mapper.select: SELECT doi.order_item_id AS orderItemId, SUM(-flow.cost_amount) AS amount FROM inventory_flow flow JOIN delivery_order_item doi ON flow.biz_type = 'DELIVERY_ORDER' AND flow.biz_id = doi.delivery_id AND flow.sku_id = doi.sku_id WHERE flow.flow_type = 'OUT_SHIP' AND flow.cost_amount IS NOT NULL AND doi.order_item_id IN #{id} GROUP BY doi.order_item_id

SELECT sd.shop_id AS shopId, sd.order_item_id AS platformOrderItemId, SUM(sd.amount) AS amount FROM settlement_detail sd WHERE sd.fee_type = 'COMMISSION' AND sd.order_item_id IN #{id} GROUP BY sd.shop_id, sd.order_item_id
